body.para: Changes the structure of an existing table.

ALTER TABLE <TableName> ADD [COLUMN] <FieldName> <FieldType> [(<nWidth> [, <nPrecision>])] [NULL | NOT NULL]
ALTER TABLE <TableName> ALTER [COLUMN] <FieldName> <FieldType> [(<nWidth> [, <nPrecision>])] [NULL | NOT NULL]
ALTER TABLE <TableName> DROP [COLUMN] <FieldName>
ADD [COLUMN]Adds a new field to the table.
ALTER [COLUMN]Changes the type, size or NULL setting of an existing field.
DROP [COLUMN]Removes a field from the table.

The table is rebuilt. The old table is kept as a backup file with the extension .BAK (and .TBK for the memo file) until the new table has been created successfully. Field types and clauses are the same as for CREATE TABLE.

NOT SUPPORTED AT THIS MOMENT: The variations of the command that change table properties or constraints (such as primary and foreign keys, rules and triggers) are accepted by the preprocessor but are ignored.
